versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or skill logic.
- No user-facing features or content were altered in this version.

Initial release with comprehensive guidelines for generating a long-form, timeline-driven article on the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period (907–979) in Simplified Chinese.

- Supports ~5000-character, citation-rich narrative articles with map links and FAQ, suitable for general readers.
- Strictly defines historical scope, source reliability, and default output (Markdown with clear structure).
- Includes detailed requirements for each article section: timeline, regime changes, major events, significant figures, economy, culture, ethnics, territory, and frequently asked questions.
- Special focus on accurate presentation of Li Yu and South Tang culture, with verified works and scholarly interpretations.
- Outlines workflow, content boundaries, referencing standards, and built-in quality checklist.
- Recommends placing supplementary materials (timeline, FAQ) in a dedicated references/ directory.
